content: Investigate INC-4917 and remediate it safely.

Root cause: release rel‑2031 lowered the DB pool maximumPoolSize from 50 to 10, causing connection exhaustion and a 1800 ms HikariPool timeout.  
Action: rolled back checkout‑api to the previous stable release rel‑2030 (v2.13.4).  
Verification: p95 latency dropped below the 400 ms SLO for the last 3 minutes (latest value 210 ms).
